risks.proof: Video showing the console powering on, booting up, and playing a game from a disc or memory card.

risks.proof: Video showing both controllers connecting to the console and responding to button presses.

risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic or counterfeit unit

risks.risk: Hacking and game storage may be compromised or not working
